review.shorterRoute: Use native Module.End.baseChangeHom on the literal tensor reduction of the original finite integral H1 module. Its image is a finite operator algebra. The existing tensor-to-coefficient comparison sends a zero tensor operator to a zero original coefficient-reduced operator, so scope 585 gives the character-kernel inclusion. Native RingHom.liftOfSurjective descends the same original character. This avoids new H2 torsion/transfer infrastructure, surjectivity from integral H1 onto all residual cohomology, and eigenvector lifting.
